data.narrative:
Diode is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Davide Asnaghi and Lenny Khazan that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of nine private robotics firms (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and one public comparable on the Korean exchange (277810.KQ).

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach, using the $10M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. A peer-median analysis was not executable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while ten same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of three datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacency, or valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias.

The triangulated range derived from stage-progression methodology is $21M to $29M, with a median of $25M. This estimate rests on a single methodological pillar, which constrains confidence. Key uncertainties include the actual post-Seed valuation step-up appropriate to Diode's specific product maturity and market traction—the 2.5x multiplier reflects median practice but may not capture company-specific factors. A more robust valuation would require either additional Robotics & Manufacturing comps at comparable stages or direct comparable transaction data from the sector.
